finding.title: Cross-customer account read (BOLA)
finding.summary: Attacker session read account acc_alice_1 owned by "alice", including a balance of ₹2500000.00.

violations.detail: account object returned to a non-owner identity

finding.exposure: Customer financial data (balances, identifiers) readable across tenants
finding.remediation: Enforce owner/tenant check on every object lookup server-side; return 404 for foreign objects; add an authorization test per object route.

controls.title: Broken Object Level Authorization

finding.title: Step-up OTP attempt ceiling
finding.summary: 11 consecutive wrong OTPs were accepted for evaluation without lockout (last response HTTP 401). A 4-digit OTP space falls to ~10,000 requests.
finding.exposure: Step-up authentication bypass on high-value actions (account takeover, beneficiary add)
finding.remediation: Lock the challenge after ≤5 failures, bind it to device/session, rate-limit per account and per IP, and alert on bursts.

controls.title: Invalid authentication attempts are limited (lockout after not more than 10 attempts)

controls.ref: Master Direction on Digital Payment Security Controls (2021)

finding.title: Negative-amount transfer pulls funds
finding.summary: A transfer of -₹1.00 from the attacker's account debited the victim by ₹1.00. Any customer balance can be drained by naming it as the destination.

violations.detail: victim account debited without victim's authority

finding.exposure: Entire balance of any reachable account (victim test account alone: ₹2500000.00)
finding.remediation: Reject amount <= 0 at the API edge and again in the posting engine; express transfers as unsigned amount + direction.

Reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breach

finding.title: FX rounding round-trip mints money
finding.summary: 10 INR→USD→INR round-trips of ₹0.01 created ₹8.40 that no GL absorbs (₹0.84 per trip). Rounding is applied in the customer's favour on both legs while treasury books the fair value.

violations.detail: system total for INR moved by ₹0.10 with no external inflow
system total for USD moved by $0.10 with no external inflow

finding.remediation: Round toward the bank on every leg, enforce a minimum conversion amount, book rounding residue to a dedicated GL and reconcile it daily.

finding.title: Duplicate idempotency key double-posts
finding.summary: Two in-flight requests with idempotency key "lg-idem-1795107055777735743" produced 2 distinct postings. Client retries (mobile network flaps, gateway timeouts) will double-debit customers.
finding.exposure: Every retried payment is at risk of duplicate debit; customer-harm and chargeback exposure scales with retry rate
finding.remediation: Reserve the idempotency key atomically (unique insert) before executing, scope it to the caller, and bind it to a hash of the payload.

controls.title: Software engineering techniques prevent common attacks, including business-logic abuse via API manipulation

finding.title: Concurrent transfers overdraw the source
finding.summary: 6 of 6 concurrent transfers of the full balance (₹1007.30) posted. The source ended at -₹5036.50: the balance check and the debit are not atomic.

violations.detail: account acc_mallory_1 is overdrawn at -₹5036.50 with no overdraft facility

finding.exposure: ₹5036.50 overdrawn from a ₹1007.30 balance in one burst; scales linearly with concurrency and account count
finding.remediation: Debit with a conditional update (UPDATE … SET bal = bal - x WHERE bal >= x) or a row lock inside the posting transaction; move fraud checks before the reservation, not between check and debit.
